Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the list of U.S. Secretaries of Homeland Security before April 2019. Specifically, it omitted **Michael Chertoff** (who served from 2005-2009) and **Jeh Johnson** (who served from 2013-2017) from the initial list of secretaries it manually extracted after the scraping failure. This omission led to the exclusion of their universities (Harvard and Morehouse College) from the final analysis, causing the agent to incorrectly identify Santa Clara as the westernmost city (when Morehouse in Atlanta is further west) and Cambridge as the easternmost city (when Georgetown in Washington D.C. is further east). This error occurred in the first step of the conversation where the agent attempted to extract the list of secretaries.
